Chapter 3
Requirement Analysis
3.1
Introduction
Requirement analysis is one of the most important phases in software development. It
identifies the functional and non-functional requirements of the system before implemen-
tation begins. A well-defined requirement analysis ensures that the developed system
fulfills user expectations while maintaining security, scalability, performance, and usabil-
ity.
The Intelligent Research Assistant is designed to provide secure document manage-
ment, semantic search, and AI-powered question answering using Retrieval-Augmented
Generation (RAG). The system combines modern web technologies with Artificial Intel-
ligence to deliver reliable and context-aware responses from user-uploaded documents.
3.2
Functional Requirements
The functional requirements describe the features that the system must provide.
3.2.1
User Authentication
The system shall provide:
• User Registration
• Secure Login
• Password Hashing using bcrypt
• JWT Token Generation
• Logout Functionality
• User Profile Management
